sources.snippet: This repo holds the official weights of BiRefNet_lite trained in 2K resolution. Training Sets: DIS5K (except DIS-VD) HRS10K UHRSD P3M-10k (except TE-P3M-500-NP) TR-humans AM-2k AIM-500 Human-2k (synthesized with BG-20k) Distinctions-646 (synthesized with BG-20k) HIM2K PPM-100 HR samples selection:
